units.source_text: 他的微笑依然是那麼平靜，我直冒冷汗。

en.t: His smile was still so calm that I broke into a cold sweat.

units.source_text: 不，即使現在回想起來，仍發怵得心慌。

en.t: No, even now, when I think back on it, I still feel frightened and panicky.

units.source_text: 中學時代，那個蠢貨竹一曾用手指戳著我的後背說「故意的、故意的」，

en.t: In middle school, that fool Takeichi once poked me in the back with his finger and said, "You did it on purpose, on purpose,"

units.source_text: 被他一腳踹進地獄，比起當時，此刻的驚慌可以說是有過之而無不及。

en.t: when he kicked me straight down into hell; compared with that time, my panic now was, if anything, even greater.

units.source_text: 那次與這次，是我的人生中演技最為失敗的記錄。

en.t: That time and this time are the records of the greatest failures of acting in my life.

units.source_text: 我有時甚至覺得，與其遭受檢察官平靜的侮辱，還不如宣判我十年徒刑好呢。

en.t: Sometimes I even think that rather than suffer the prosecutor's calm insult, I would have been better off being sentenced to ten years in prison.
But I was not happy at all.

units.source_text: 滿懷悲涼地坐在檢察局休息室的長椅上，等候擔保人比目魚的到來。

en.t: Filled with desolation, I sat on a bench in the prosecutor's office waiting room, waiting for my guarantor, Hirame, to arrive.
